title: tripleurospermum rupestre
intro: Tripleurospermum rupestre, commonly known as Alpine Meadow Parsley or Mountain Chervil, is a species of flowering plant in the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is used in herbal medicine to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms of colds and flu due to its therapeutic actions of expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The health benefits of Tripleurospermum rupestre include its ability to soothe coughs, reduce fever, and ease respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
